en: This is a black-and-white historical postcard depicting an indoor scene of a gymnastics class. The room features gymnastic equipment such as vaulting horses and horizontal bars. Several men and boys, some in uniform or formal attire, are present; some appear to be engaged in exercise while others observe. Framed pictures hang on the walls, and sunlight streams through large windows. The postcard bears printed text in two languages and a publisher's mark on the left margin.
